baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening sequence at words 1-4: eat, drink, and let the eye settle.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intake restores the body, then ocular settling restores affect and perception before the conditional human encounter begins.

activation_trace.role: Literal taking of food begins the bodily replenishment sequence.
Literal taking of liquid completes immediate physical replenishment.
The eye-settling sense converts nourishment into affective quiet.
The physical eye anchors the restored calm in perception rather than abstraction.

changed_reading.after: A sequenced recovery protocol restores body, affect, and perception before social exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 10-18: declare a vow of fasting and do not speak today to any human.
baseline_models.mechanism: A self-binding vow specifies fasting as a day-bounded suspension of reciprocal human speech; the commanded declaration marks the boundary rather than contradicting it.

activation_trace.role: An audible declaration publicly marks the rule that follows.
Self-imposed obligation makes silence a binding practice rather than incapacity.
The tongue-abstention branch identifies the operative domain of this fast.
Reciprocal intelligible speech is the interaction being suspended.
The named day supplies a finite temporal boundary.

changed_reading.before: A general fast accompanied by silence.
changed_reading.after: A precisely declared, time-bounded speech fast that permits its own boundary-setting formula.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vow is addressed to al-Rahman at word 13 while food, drink, and speech-specific fasting surround it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory lets mercy, the womb, and post-birth pain coexist at the divine epithet; bodily nourishment plus tongue-abstention therefore frame the vow as protected maternal recovery, not bodily deprivation.

activation_trace.role: Compassion makes the vow's governing relation protective.
The womb branch gives the epithet a maternal bodily resonance.
The post-birth pain branch keeps physical vulnerability active in the vow.
Restricting the fast to speech preserves the preceding bodily care.

changed_reading.before: The divine name simply receives an ascetic vow.
changed_reading.after: The Merciful receives a speech-specific vow nested in womb, post-birth, and restorative resonances.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier withdrawal and a physical screen protect Mary in space; when she returns to her people, the focus vow converts that protection into a portable boundary governing human access through speech.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal to a side establishes the first spatial mode of protection.
A screening barrier makes the earlier protection materially explicit.
Repeated withdrawal shows that separation has been her recurring defense.
The assembled people create the social field in which a spatial screen can no longer suffice.
The human addressee anchors the new barrier specifically at social contact.

structural_cues: 19:16-17 pairs withdrawal with a screen; 19:22 repeats withdrawal; 19:27 reverses direction by bringing her to her people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated seclusion, a material barrier, and public re-entry; I infer that vowed silence carries the barrier into the crowd; alternatively, the vow may be only a ritual observance unrelated to the earlier spatial pattern.

changed_reading.before: A private vow to avoid conversation.
changed_reading.after: A portable social barrier that replaces physical seclusion when Mary re-enters communal space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence reverses a wish for death and erasure: grief is checked, ripe food is made to fall within reach and be gathered, and the focus commands culminate in the eye's settled presence.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the extreme starting point from which recovery must move.
The discarded, forgotten thing supplies the desired erasure of social presence.
The roughness of grief names the affect that the following provisions answer.
Downward falling brings provision to her rather than carrying her toward disappearance.
Gathering produce turns the fall into usable nourishment.
The settled eye is the endpoint opposite death, forgetting, and grief.

structural_cues: 19:23 moves toward death and being forgotten; 19:24-26 moves through no-grief, reachable provision, intake, and settled sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the death-wish, erasure language, grief prohibition, falling fruit, and ocular settling; I infer a causal recovery arc from self-erasure to embodied presence; alternatively, these may be adjacent consolations without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: Let your eye be comforted after distress.
changed_reading.after: Become stably present again through a material and affective reversal of the wish to die and be forgotten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus declaration suspends Mary's reciprocal speech just before accusation; her gesture redirects the crowd's demand, and intelligible speech then comes from the child, reallocating testimony rather than suppressing it.

activation_trace.role: The fabrication branch makes false attribution the immediate speech pressure facing Mary.
A bodily indication becomes the nonverbal routing action.
The crowd's question explicitly relocates the expected conversation to the child.
The child's audible speech supplies the testimony Mary does not provide.
Tongue-abstention creates the vacant speaking position that gesture redirects.

structural_cues: 19:26 declaration and silence precede 19:27 accusation, 19:29 pointing and a question about speaking, and 19:30 the child's answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation, silence, pointing, redirected questioning, and the child's speech; I infer an intentional handoff of evidentiary voice; alternatively, the gesture may merely comply with the vow while the child's speech functions independently.

changed_reading.after: Mary controls the channel of testimony, shifting defense from self-assertion to sign and child.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated mercy language becomes materially legible as flowing water and ripe, gatherable food; the focus invocation of al-Rahman then names the source-character of the care surrounding the maternal body.

activation_trace.role: Compassion first appears as the refuge Mary invokes under threat.
Mercy is then named as an announced purpose of the event.
The running-flow branch supplies concrete fluid provision before the command to drink.
Ripe dates make care edible and immediately available.
Harvestability makes the provision actionable rather than merely displayed.
The post-birth pain branch ties the divine epithet back to the recovering body.

structural_cues: Al-Rahman is invoked at 19:18, mercy is stated at 19:21, provisions arrive at 19:24-25, and al-Rahman receives the vow at 19:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated mercy language, water, ripe food, and a post-birth root branch; I infer that mercy is enacted as maternal provisioning; alternatively, the divine epithet may remain devotional while the provisions carry no lexical relation to it.

changed_reading.before: Mary vows to the Merciful after being fed.
changed_reading.after: The vow is enclosed by mercy made material as refuge, water, food, and post-birth care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily-wound branch of the same root used for speaking. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is sharpened by fabrication, faulting, and dispute in context; downstream prose should present it as a lexical echo, not replace the literal prohibition on conversation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 16, normally reciprocal speech, also has a packet branch for bodily wounding.

activation_trace.role: The wound branch recasts abstention as refusal to enter an injuring exchange.
Splitting and damaging imagery gives the accusation a cutting social force.
Fault-finding extends that force into reputational injury.
Contentious verbal exchange shows the larger disputational field she does not join.

changed_reading.before: She will not converse with anyone.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, she exits a speech economy that cuts, imputes fault, and perpetuates dispute.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary r-w-y target for the focus root r-hamza-y. It remains valid as a supplied split-root activation linking quenching and report-bearing to the local drink-see-say-silence sequence; downstream prose should label it speculative resonance, not morphology or syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seeing verb at word 6 follows drinking and opens the clause that ends in withheld human speech.

activation_trace.role: The secondary target's quenching sense echoes the immediately preceding command to drink.
Its report-transmission sense pulls seeing toward the narration she declines to carry.
Literal drinking supplies the bodily intake side of the resonance.
Flowing provision strengthens the water-bearing side without determining the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: If she sees a human, she announces her silence.
changed_reading.after: A split-root resonance moves from receiving water to refusing the burden of carrying a human-facing report.

strongest_changes: Silence becomes a portable barrier that permits public return without reopening unrestricted access.
Eating, drinking, and settling the eye reverse the prior wish for death and erasure into embodied presence.
The vow reallocates testimony from Mary's self-defense to gesture and the child's speech.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah coordinates bodily recovery, a maternal mercy frame, and disciplined control of the social speech channel; its strangest live echoes are speech as wounding and the secondary seeing-root as quenching plus narration.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the womb and post-birth branches at al-Rahman are active wordplay or only packet-enabled resonance.
Whether the handoff of testimony is a designed function of the vow or a narrative consequence of it.
How much weight the form-distant r-w-y target should carry beyond exploratory synthesis.
